adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `actions.delete()` implementation calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` inside the bootbox confirm callback but does not attach a `.catch(...)` handler. Other actions (e.g. `save()`) explicitly `.catch(popupAjaxError)`, so a failed `destroyRecord()` would result in an unhandled promise rejection and no user-visible error, while the confirm dialog has already closed. The row is only removed on success via `sendAction('deleteHost', ...)`, so failure leaves the UI unchanged with no feedback.
